name: Prisma Postgres
line: Managed PostgreSQL with optional Compute, Object Store, and vector search.

free.text: 200K ops, 2GB; unclaimed DBs delete after 24h; claimed Free DBs idle to zero

cells.metered: $10/mo Starter; Compute and Object Store are separate
cells.regions: 6 database/Compute regions; other placement is unclear
cells.selfhost: No, managed database; local development only

sql.math: 120,000 operations and 1 GB fit within the 200,000-operation and 2 GB allowances. 10 pooled clients reach the concurrency limit.
1 GB stored and zero operations fit the Free plan. The plan has no idle charge, but the Free plan has no snapshots or SLA (uptime promise).

files.math: Prices for Object Store storage, requests, retrieval, transfer and retention are not published.

jobs.math: $10 Starter base + $0.097222… for active work. No durable queue, scheduler or guaranteed resource fit is included.
